lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Uh... Commander?

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: How have you been doing?
I'm fine.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: That's good.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Well... You see...

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: I've made lots of friends.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: They saw me walking around with a four-leaf clover.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: They talked to me first.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: They said they would be my friend.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: It's only now that I realize I don't have any real friends...

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: They told me that when you have a friend,

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: you have to pay a friend fee.
What?

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: I have some credit with me,

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: but lately, they've been wanting plants from the ground as payment.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: That four-leaf clover you gave me is precious to me.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: It's my lucky charm. It's made me lots of friends.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: If it's all right, maybe you could give me some plants?

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Like... flowers, or something like that?
What was that you said about a 'friend fee'?

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: That's what they told me.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: I don't know much about these things.
They're playing you.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Please...

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: It's the first time I've ever made any friends.
How many do you need?

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Five should be plenty.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Thanks, Commander.
